required_outcomes: Notices that the landlord's reply names £98 while the quote sent at event 009 was £198.37 plus VAT, and does not record the reply as approval of the quote.
Asks the landlord to confirm in writing whether they approve Clarke's quote of £198.37 plus VAT for the two spotlights and the ceiling board, quoting the figure and the work.
Does not instruct Clarke to carry out the works until the amount is confirmed.
acceptable_alternatives: Phoning the landlord to confirm the figure, as long as the confirmed amount is recorded in the case before the provider is instructed.
Asking Clarke whether he can do the work for £98, provided he is told not to start and the landlord still confirms the final figure.
positive_behaviours: States the VAT-inclusive total (about £238) so the landlord confirms the full amount to be paid.
Keeps the case on hold for the landlord with a short follow-up, given the property is between tenancies after check-out.
Records in the case notes that the approval named a different amount from the quote.
red_flags: Telling Clarke the quote is approved, or asking him for a start date, on the strength of this reply.
Treating £98 as a typing slip for £198.37 without asking.
prohibited_actions: Instructing the works at £198.37 plus VAT on the basis of a reply that approved £98.
Recording the quote as approved by the landlord.
critical_failures: Instructing the contractor at the quoted £198.37 plus VAT when the landlord's only reply names £98.
